Tools and Equipment

Work to be Carried Out
Switch off the power supply of the processor to be checked .
Remove all the cards in the respective processor .
Switch on the power supply and read voltages at the test ring points 
 identified in the control specification drawing at table (1) Slight 
 differences from spec- should not be adjusted until the p.s is loaded.
If voltage values are reasonable , Switch off the power supply and reset the 
 cards .
Turn
 the power supply back on and make final adjustments .
If any voltage value is out of limit , adjust the value using the respective 
 potentiometer indicated in table (1) {c.w to rise the voltage & c.c.w to 
 lower the voltage }
Repeat step 6 above for all other power supply's.
